query: SELECT p.execution_id FROM paused_runs p JOIN access_tokens a ON a.id=p.token_id WHERE p.execution_id=$1 AND p.pause_id=$2 AND p.signature=$3 AND p.expires_at>now() AND a.revoked_at IS NULL AND a.audience=p.audience AND (a.expires_at IS NULL OR a.expires_at>now()) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM endpoints ep WHERE ep.id=a.workspace_id) AND (a.oauth_grant IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM oauth_grants g JOIN endpoints ep ON ep.id=g.endpoint_id WHERE g.id=a.oauth_grant AND g.revoked_at IS NULL AND g.expires_at>now() AND ep.id=a.workspace_id)) FOR UPDATE OF p
